it/git-commands.# 设置全局用户名\n git config --global user.nam:
# Set the global user name
 git config --global user.name "Zhang San"

# Set the global email
 git config --global user.email "zs@example.com"

# Set the default editor
 git config --global core.editor vim

# List all settings
 git config --list
it/git-commands.# 设置别名\n git config --global alias.co ch:
# Set aliases
 git config --global alias.co checkout
 git config --global alias.br branch
 git config --global alias.ci commit
 git config --global alias.st status

# Use an alias
 git co main
it/git-commands.# 设置默认分支为 main\n git config --global ini:
# Set the default branch to main
 git config --global init.defaultBranch main
it/git-commands.# 在当前目录初始化\n git init\n\n# 指定初始分支名\n git:
# Initialize in the current directory
 git init

# Specify the initial branch name
 git init --initial-branch=main

# Create a bare repository (for servers)
 git init --bare
it/git-commands.# 克隆仓库\n git clone https://github.com/us:
# Clone a repository
 git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git

# Clone a specific branch
 git clone -b main https://github.com/user/repo.git

# Shallow clone (latest commit only)
 git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/user/repo.git
it/git-commands.# 查看详细状态\n git status\n\n# 简短输出\n git st:
# Show the detailed status
 git status

# Short output
 git status -s
it/git-commands.添加文件到暂存区: Add files to the staging area
it/git-commands.# 添加所有变更\n git add .\n git add -A\n\n# 添:
# Add all changes
 git add .
 git add -A

# Add modifications and deletions (no new files)
 git add -u

# Add specific files
 git add file1.txt file2.txt

# Add interactively
 git add -p
it/git-commands.删除文件并暂存: Delete files and stage the change
it/git-commands.# 删除文件\n git rm file.txt\n\n# 从暂存区移除但保留本:
# Delete a file
 git rm file.txt

# Remove from the index but keep it locally
 git rm --cached file.txt

# Delete a directory recursively
 git rm -r dist/
it/git-commands.# 重命名文件\n git mv old.txt new.txt\n\n# 移动:
# Rename a file
 git mv old.txt new.txt

# Move a file into a directory
 git mv file.txt src/
it/git-commands.# 撤销工作区修改\n git restore file.txt\n\n# 取消:
# Discard working tree changes
 git restore file.txt

# Unstage (keep the changes)
 git restore --staged file.txt

# Restore from a specific commit
 git restore --source=HEAD~1 file.txt
it/git-commands.# 暂存当前修改\n git stash\n git stash save \":
# Stash the current changes
 git stash
 git stash save "work in progress"

# List the stashes
 git stash list

# Apply the latest stash (and drop it)
 git stash pop

# Apply without dropping
 git stash apply stash@{0}

# Drop a stash
 git stash drop stash@{0}

# Clear all stashes
 git stash clear
it/git-commands.# 提交并写消息\n git commit -m \"feat: 添加登录功能\:
# Commit with a message
 git commit -m "feat: add login feature"

# Skip add, commit tracked files directly
 git commit -am "fix: fix a bug"

# Amend the previous commit (append changes)
 git add new-file.txt
 git commit --amend --no-edit

# Change the commit message
 git commit --amend -m "new message"
it/git-commands.# 查看历史\n git log\n\n# 单行显示\n git log --o:
# Show the history
 git log

# One line per commit
 git log --oneline

# Show branches as a graph
 git log --oneline --graph --all

# Commits by a given author
 git log --author="Zhang San"

# Show the last 10 commits
 git log -n 10

# Commits since a given date
 git log --since="2 weeks ago"

# Show the diff of every commit
 git log -p
it/git-commands.# 查看最新提交\n git show\n\n# 查看指定提交\n git sh:
# Show the latest commit
 git show

# Show a specific commit
 git show abc1234

# Show a file at a given commit
 git show abc1234:file.txt
it/git-commands.# 查看工作区与暂存区差异\n git diff\n\n# 查看暂存区与最新提交:
# Working tree vs staging area
 git diff

# Staging area vs latest commit
 git diff --staged
 git diff --cached

# Compare two commits
 git diff abc1234 def5678

# Compare branches
 git diff main feature

# Diff of a specific file
 git diff file.txt
it/git-commands.查看每行最后修改: Show the last change of each line
it/git-commands.# 查看文件每行的修改者\n git blame file.txt\n\n# 查:
# Show who changed each line
 git blame file.txt

# Show a range of lines
 git blame -L 10,20 file.txt
it/git-commands.# 列出本地分支\n git branch\n\n# 列出所有分支（含远程）\n:
# List local branches
 git branch

# List all branches (including remotes)
 git branch -a

# Create a branch
 git branch feature

# Delete a branch
 git branch -d feature

# Force delete
 git branch -D feature

# Rename a branch
 git branch -m old-name new-name

# Show tracking information
 git branch -vv
it/git-commands.# 切换分支\n git checkout main\n\n# 创建并切换分支\:
# Switch branch
 git checkout main

# Create and switch to a branch
 git checkout -b feature

# Force create a branch
 git checkout -B feature origin/feature

# Switch to the previous branch
 git checkout -
it/git-commands.# 切换分支\n git switch main\n\n# 创建并切换\n gi:
# Switch branch
 git switch main

# Create and switch
 git switch -c feature

# Switch to a remote branch
 git switch origin/feature
it/git-commands.# 合并 feature 到当前分支\n git merge feature\n:
# Merge feature into the current branch
 git merge feature

# No fast-forward (keep branch history)
 git merge --no-ff feature

# Squash merge (into a single commit)
 git merge --squash feature
 git commit -m "merge feature"

# Abort the merge
 git merge --abort
it/git-commands.# 变基到 main\n git rebase main\n\n# 交互式变基（:
# Rebase onto main
 git rebase main

# Interactive rebase (squash / reorder commits)
 git rebase -i HEAD~3

# Rebase onto a specific commit
 git rebase --onto main feature

# Abort the rebase
 git rebase --abort

# Continue after resolving conflicts
 git rebase --continue
it/git-commands.# 应用单个提交\n git cherry-pick abc1234\n\n#:
# Apply a single commit
 git cherry-pick abc1234

# Apply several commits
 git cherry-pick abc1234 def5678

# Apply without committing
 git cherry-pick --no-commit abc1234
it/git-commands.# 列出远程\n git remote -v\n\n# 添加远程\n git r:
# List remotes
 git remote -v

# Add a remote
 git remote add origin https://github.com/user/repo.git

# Change the remote URL
 git remote set-url origin git@github.com:user/repo.git

# Remove a remote
 git remote remove origin

# Rename a remote
 git remote rename origin upstream
it/git-commands.# 拉取所有远程\n git fetch --all\n\n# 拉取指定远程\n:
# Fetch all remotes
 git fetch --all

# Fetch a specific remote
 git fetch origin

# Fetch a specific branch
 git fetch origin main
it/git-commands.# 拉取并合并\n git pull origin main\n\n# 拉取并变:
# Pull and merge
 git pull origin main

# Pull and rebase
 git pull --rebase origin main
it/git-commands.# 推送当前分支\n git push\n\n# 推送并设置上游\n git p:
# Push the current branch
 git push

# Push and set the upstream
 git push -u origin feature

# Force push (dangerous!)
 git push -f
 git push --force-with-lease

# Push tags
 git push --tags

# Push all branches
 git push --all
it/git-commands.# 删除远程分支\n git push origin --delete feat:
# Delete a remote branch
 git push origin --delete feature
it/git-commands.# 单行历史\n git log --oneline\n\n# 图形化所有分支\:
# One line per commit
 git log --oneline

# Graph of all branches
 git log --oneline --graph --all

# History of a specific file
 git log --oneline -- file.txt
it/git-commands.# 查看引用日志\n git reflog\n\n# 查看所有引用\n git:
# Show the reflog
 git reflog

# Show all refs
 git reflog --all

# Recover a lost commit
 git reset --hard HEAD@{5}
it/git-commands.# 列出标签\n git tag\n git tag -l 'v1.*'\n\n:
# List tags
 git tag
 git tag -l 'v1.*'

# Create a lightweight tag
 git tag v1.0.0

# Create an annotated tag
 git tag -a v1.0.0 -m "Release 1.0.0"

# Tag a specific commit
 git tag -a v1.0.0 abc1234

# Push tags
 git push origin v1.0.0
 git push origin --tags

# Delete a tag
 git tag -d v1.0.0
 git push origin --delete v1.0.0
it/git-commands.# 软重置（保留修改）\n git reset --soft HEAD~1\n\:
# Soft reset (keep the changes)
 git reset --soft HEAD~1

# Default reset (unstage, keep the changes)
 git reset HEAD~1

# Hard reset (discard changes, dangerous!)
 git reset --hard HEAD~1

# Reset to a specific commit
 git reset --hard abc1234
it/git-commands.# 撤销最新提交\n git revert HEAD\n\n# 撤销指定提交\n:
# Revert the latest commit
 git revert HEAD

# Revert a specific commit
 git revert abc1234

# Revert without committing
 git revert --no-commit abc1234
it/git-commands.# 预览将删除的文件\n git clean -n\n\n# 删除未跟踪文件\n:
# Preview the files to be removed
 git clean -n

# Remove untracked files
 git clean -f

# Remove untracked directories
 git clean -fd

# Remove everything untracked (including ignored)
 git clean -fdx
it/git-commands.# 丢弃单个文件\n git checkout -- file.txt\n\n#:
# Discard one file
 git checkout -- file.txt

# Discard all changes
 git checkout -- .
it/git-commands.# 创建附注标签\n git tag -a v1.0.0 -m \"Releas:
# Create an annotated tag
 git tag -a v1.0.0 -m "Release 1.0.0"

# Create it on a specific commit
 git tag -a v1.0.0 abc1234 -m "Release 1.0.0"
it/git-commands.# 描述最近的标签\n git describe\n\n# 使用轻量标签\n g:
# Describe from the nearest tag
 git describe

# Use lightweight tags
 git describe --tags
it/git-commands.# 列出所有暂存\n git stash list:
# List all stashes
 git stash list
it/git-commands.# 恢复最近的暂存\n git stash pop\n\n# 恢复指定暂存\n:
# Apply the latest stash
 git stash pop

# Apply a specific stash
 git stash pop stash@{2}
it/git-commands.# 添加子模块\n git submodule add https://gith:
# Add a submodule
 git submodule add https://github.com/user/lib.git libs/lib

# Initialize submodules
 git submodule init
 git submodule update

# Initialize and update in one step
 git submodule update --init --recursive

# Remove a submodule
 git submodule deinit libs/lib
 git rm libs/lib
it/git-commands.在所有子模块执行命令: Run a command in every submodule
it/git-commands.# 在所有子模块拉取\n git submodule foreach git p:
# Pull in every submodule
 git submodule foreach git pull
it/git-commands.# 初始化 Git Flow\n git flow init:
# Initialize Git Flow
 git flow init
it/git-commands.# 开始新功能\n git flow feature start my-feat:
# Start a new feature
 git flow feature start my-feature

# Finish the feature
 git flow feature finish my-feature

# Publish the feature branch
 git flow feature publish my-feature

# Check out the feature branch
 git flow feature checkout my-feature
it/git-commands.# 开始发布\n git flow release start 1.0.0\n\:
# Start a release
 git flow release start 1.0.0

# Finish the release
 git flow release finish 1.0.0
it/git-commands.# 开始热修复\n git flow hotfix start hotfix-1:
# Start a hotfix
 git flow hotfix start hotfix-1.0.1

# Finish the hotfix
 git flow hotfix finish hotfix-1.0.1
it/git-commands.# 开始二分\n git bisect start\n\n# 标记坏提交\n g:
# Start bisecting
 git bisect start

# Mark a bad commit
 git bisect bad HEAD

# Mark a good commit
 git bisect good v1.0.0

# Run an automated test
 git bisect run npm test

# End bisecting
 git bisect reset
it/git-commands.# 添加工作树\n git worktree add ../repo-featu:
# Add a working tree
 git worktree add ../repo-feature feature

# List working trees
 git worktree list

# Remove a working tree
 git worktree remove ../repo-feature
it/git-commands.# 归档为 zip\n git archive --format=zip --o:
# Archive as zip
 git archive --format=zip --output=repo.zip HEAD

# Archive as tar.gz
 git archive --format=tar.gz --output=repo.tar.gz HEAD
it/git-commands.# 垃圾回收\n git gc\n\n# 深度清理\n git gc --agg:
# Collect garbage
 git gc

# Deep clean
 git gc --aggressive --prune=now
it/git-commands.# 按作者统计提交数\n git shortlog -sn:
# Count commits per author
 git shortlog -sn
it/git-commands.# 查看帮助\n git help\n git help commit\n gi:
# Show help
 git help
 git help commit
 git help push
it/git-commands.# 拉取并变基\n git pull --rebase origin main\:
# Pull and rebase
 git pull --rebase origin main

# Make rebase the default for pull
 git config --global pull.rebase true
it/git-commands.# 合并保留分支历史\n git merge --no-ff feature\n:
# Merge keeping branch history
 git merge --no-ff feature

# Disable fast-forward by default
 git config --global merge.ff false
it/git-commands.# 修改提交信息\n git commit --amend -m \"新的消息\:
# Change the commit message
 git commit --amend -m "new message"

# Add files to the last commit
 git add new-file.txt
 git commit --amend --no-edit

# Change the author
 git commit --amend --author="Zhang San <zs@example.com>"
it/git-commands.# 编辑最近 3 次提交\n git rebase -i HEAD~3\n# 在:
# Edit the last 3 commits
 git rebase -i HEAD~3
# In the editor you can:
# pick   - keep
# reword - change the message
# squash - merge into the previous one
# drop   - remove
# edit   - stop to amend
it/git-commands.# 从其他分支取单个提交\n git cherry-pick abc1234\n:
# Take a single commit from another branch
 git cherry-pick abc1234

# Take several commits
 git cherry-pick abc1234 def5678
it/git-commands.# 查看引用日志\n git reflog\n\n# 恢复到 5 步前\n gi:

 git reflog
